voice.summary: Sounds like a helpful colleague in the team chat who happens to know payroll: casual, quick and reassuring. Customers do the talking and the brand keeps replies short.
dos: Let customers quote in their own words
Keep payroll terms plain: pay day, payslip, tax
Use short messages and the occasional emoji
donts: No compliance jargon in marketing lines
Never invent quotes without a first name

taglines: Payroll people actually message us about
Pay day, sorted in one thread
boilerplate: Wagewise is payroll software for small teams that runs pay day, payslips and tax filings, and supports customers through a fast, friendly chat.
